ExportFormat.description: What `export` writes: 3MF, each body a mesh, as a slicer prints it.

FeatureId.description: A feature's ID: 8 characters of Crockford's base32 in lower case (digits and letters but i, l, o, and u).

Length.description: A length in millimetres: a number, to at most 6 decimals (nanometres). An exponent is read exactly; Silico writes plain decimals. (Strings are reserved for expressions, which aren't read yet.)

request.description:
`export`'s request: the current model's bodies, or the features named, written as a
file, each solid meshed at the tolerance.

features.description:
The features whose solids to write, each by its ID, in the file's order; or null,
for every body.

path.description:
Where to write it: a path in the workspace ending in the format's extension, never a
document or its cache.

replace.description: Whether to replace a file already at `path`.

session.description: The session's ID, as `open` gave it.

tolerance.description:
The mesh's tolerance, in mm, from 0.00001 to 100000000: the mesher's linear
deflection, as FreeCAD's export takes it (its default is 0.1).

request.title: ExportRequest

ExportedObject.description: An object of an export: one solid's mesh.

feature.description: The feature whose solid it is.

left_out.description:
The faces left out of the mesh as bounding no material (OCCT's INTERNAL and
EXTERNAL), by their names: none for most parts.

name.description: The feature's name, the object's name in the file.

volume.description: The mesh's volume, in mm³, computed in doubles from the coordinates as written.

FeatureId.description: A feature's ID: 8 characters of Crockford's base32 in lower case (digits and letters but i, l, o, and u).

Measure.description: A volume (mm³) or area (mm²): a number, to at most 6 decimals.

objects.description: Each object in the file, in its order.

path.description: Where the file was written, as the request gave it.
